name: cartly
description: Cartly modular monolith e-commerce technical assessment

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec backend npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec backend npm run prisma:seed
